why: Rule family 9 and spec 006 §13 Q4: derived image bytes committed to the repository stay under a 6 MB cap. Since TASK-138's split (founder, 2026-10-03, option (a)) only the site-origin `hero` slot is committed — every other slot is served from the media bucket — so the cap measures that ladder alone, and it still has to fire. The fixture replaces the committed-file listing, the tree-level fact the gate measures, with two oversized `home-hero` files, and empties the variants manifest with it so the case tests the byte cap and nothing else.
